summary: Reproduced and root-caused the 'Dados para Laudo fields are not saved' bug. The OrderDetailModal autosave works correctly (PUT 200, payload OK, backend persisted). The actual bug lives in LaudoModal: its autosave PUT to /api/service-orders/{os} overwrites OS laudo fields with stale (empty) values because LaudoModal receives the parent's STALE order snapshot — not the updated editedOrder from OrderDetailModal. When the user fills a field in OrderDetailModal, then opens LaudoModal and types anything (autosave fires every 600ms), LaudoModal posts technical_diagnosis='', voltage_f1f2='', installation_correct='', etc. wiping the freshly-saved data.

ui_bugs.issue: Builds OS PUT payload as { technical_diagnosis: fd.technical_diagnosis || '', installation_correct: fd.installation_correct || '', voltage_f1f2: fnd.voltage_f1f2 || '', voltage_f1_terra: fnd.voltage_f1_terra || '', voltage_f2_terra: fnd.voltage_f2_terra || '', technician: fnd.technician || '', model/serial/etc... }. Because LaudoModal received a STALE `order` snapshot from ServiceOrdersPage (parent never refreshes after OrderDetailModal autosaves), every empty/unfilled field is sent as '' to the OS, OVERWRITING the data the user just typed in OrderDetailModal. Reproduction: empty OS → in OrderDetailModal type technical_diagnosis='ABC' (autosaves OK, backend has 'ABC') → click 'Gerar Laudo' → in LaudoModal type only Peças='XYZ' → backend now has technical_diagnosis='' and required_parts='XYZ' (i.e. ABC was destroyed). Verified via Playwright + curl.

When clicking 'Gerar Laudo' from inside an open OrderDetailModal, the LaudoModal receives the parent's `order` (a snapshot of the row from the OS list query) instead of the LIVE `editedOrder` currently being edited. So even after OrderDetailModal autosaves successfully, LaudoModal sees pre-edit values. This is the upstream cause that combines with the bug above to produce data loss.

integration_issues.flow: OS Detail → Gerar Laudo round-trip sync
integration_issues.issue: OrderDetailModal → backend round-trip is correct; LaudoModal → backend writes the laudo draft AND syncs into OS. But LaudoModal's OS sync uses stale field values, so the 'sync' is destructive rather than additive.

action_items: Fix LaudoModal runLaudoSave (lines 306-323): do NOT send fields the user hasn't actually edited in LaudoModal. Either (a) re-fetch the latest OS via GET /api/service-orders/{os} just before the PUT and merge, or (b) only include keys that differ from the initially-loaded order snapshot, or (c) drop OS-only laudo fields from the OS PUT and rely on OrderDetailModal as the sole writer for those.

Refresh parent's `order` after OrderDetailModal autosave (or pass editedOrder down to LaudoModal). Suggested: in handleOpenLaudo, GET the latest OS before opening LaudoModal, OR make ServiceOrdersPage update its order list after each PUT.
Add a regression test: open OS → set technical_diagnosis='ABC' → open LaudoModal → type required_parts='XYZ' → close → assert backend has technical_diagnosis='ABC' AND required_parts='XYZ'.
(Optional UX) Show 'Sincronizando com OS...' indicator when LaudoModal opens, and confirm the user-visible fields reflect the just-saved OS values.
critical_code_review_comments: LaudoModal.runLaudoSave is destructive-by-default: any unfilled OS field is force-blanked. Pattern `fd.x || ''` should only be used for keys the user really did interact with in the laudo form.

OrderDetailModal autosave (ServiceOrdersPage.js 1704-1732) is correct and proven by E2E: PUT fires within 800ms, payload contains exactly the edited fields plus existing non-photo fields, backend returns 200, GET reflects persisted values.
Backend PUT /api/service-orders/{os_number} accepts partial ServiceOrderUpdate correctly — confirmed via curl. Nothing to fix server-side.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend PUT /api/service-orders/27691 is healthy. The user's reported symptom ('fields don't save in OS modal') is misleading: OrderDetailModal autosave works perfectly. The real bug is that LaudoModal's autosave OVERWRITES the OS laudo fields with empty strings because (1) LaudoModal receives a stale `order` prop from ServiceOrdersPage and (2) runLaudoSave force-sends every laudo field on every save. To retest the fix: (a) reset OS 27691 to empty laudo fields via PUT; (b) login, open OS 27691, fill modal-technical-diagnosis='X', wait 2s; (c) verify backend has technical_diagnosis='X' via curl; (d) click Gerar Laudo, select Laudo Hisense, fill ONLY Peças Necessárias='Y', wait 2s; (e) verify backend still has technical_diagnosis='X' AND required_parts='Y'. Currently step (e) FAILS (technical_diagnosis becomes '').

rca of the issue.root_cause: Two-part defect. (1) ServiceOrdersPage passes the row-list snapshot to LaudoModal as `order` prop; that snapshot is NEVER refreshed after OrderDetailModal autosaves. (2) LaudoModal.runLaudoSave (LaudoModal.js 306-323) unconditionally builds the OS PUT body with every laudo field defaulted to '' (`fd.technical_diagnosis || ''`, etc.), so any field the user didn't touch in the laudo wizard goes back to backend as empty string, overwriting whatever OrderDetailModal just saved.
rca of the issue.reproduction: 1) curl PUT /api/service-orders/27691 {technical_diagnosis:'',required_parts:''} to reset. 2) Login as admin, search 27691, open modal. 3) Type 'ABC' into [data-testid=modal-technical-diagnosis]. 4) Wait 2s. curl GET shows technical_diagnosis='ABC'. 5) Click 'Gerar Laudo' → 'Laudo Hisense'. 6) Type 'XYZ' into 'Peças Necessárias' textarea inside LaudoModal. 7) Wait 2s. curl GET now shows technical_diagnosis='' (data lost) and required_parts='XYZ'.
rca of the issue.mitigation_applied: None — testing-agent scope is bug identification. Main agent should fix LaudoModal.js 306-323 + ServiceOrdersPage handleOpenLaudo as described in action_items.
